title: Before the first close the report, chip and export option are not shown
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization that has never closed an internal or no-charge work order nor invoiced a no-charge line.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports.
  2. Open Reports > Technician Efficiency.
  3. Open Export Reports.
  4. Open the Internal Work Orders report's direct link.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • "Internal Work Orders" is not listed among the reports, while the other reports are.

Step 2:

  • The "Internal work orders" chip is not shown.

Step 3:

  • The Customer Invoice export has no "Include internal and no-charge work orders" option.

Step 4:

  • The standard report empty state shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R4: “The Internal Work Orders report appears in the Reports list once the organization has closed its first internal or no-charge work order or invoiced its first work order with a no-charge line, and stays listed from then on for good, with the setting on or off and even if every closed one is later reopened, so history stays reachable (ShopView remembers that first Close or invoice for the organization; it is not derived from the closed records). Before that it is not listed, and a direct link to it shows the standard empty state. The Technician Efficiency chip (S9-R3) and the export option (S9-R6) follow the same rule (S9-N1).”
  • S9-N1: “If the organization has never closed an internal or no-charge work order nor invoiced a work order with a no-charge line, the Internal Work Orders report is not listed, the Technician Efficiency chip is not shown and the export option is not shown, whatever the setting; from that first Close or invoice on, all three show for good, with the setting on or off (S9-R4). With no row matching the filters the report shows the standard empty state.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Report with no matching rows | Standard report empty state | Also on a direct link before the first Close”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
